title: Q13
description:
“The Son who has been perfected forever.”
Read: Exo 29:9, 29, 33, Heb 2:10, Heb 4:15
a) Where the NKJV says “consecrate” (Exo 29:9, 29, 33), the Hebrew is literally “fill the hand,” and the Greek Old Testament renders it “perfect the hands.” What does that bring forward about “perfected” here, given He was already without sin?
